pages.text: These artifacts are in the Anput Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Anput to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.
A bow that fires slowing arrows. Use it to limit a pursuing target’s movement.
Hold this dagger in your main hand. Striking a living enemy restores a little food and inflicts brief nausea. Holding it without fighting periodically drains food.
